gloss: division into two; splitting in half

definitions.gloss: division into two; splitting into two parts
definitions.explanation: Dividing something into two parts, or two sides splitting something evenly between them. Often used of opinion, votes, or territory: {世論|よろん}を{二分|にぶん}する (to split public opinion in two).

definitions.gloss: one half (in the fraction {二分|にぶん}の{一|いち})
definitions.explanation: In arithmetic, {二分|にぶん}の{一|いち} is the fraction one half. The pattern is 'denominator + {分|ぶん}の + numerator', so {三分|さんぶん}の{二|に} is two thirds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世論|よろん}→世論：16145_yoron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二分|にぶん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ。
examples.english: It is an issue that splits public opinion in two.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{二分|にぶん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The brothers divided the land between them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天下|てんか}→天下：12188_tenka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二分|にぶん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{百年|ひゃくねん}→百年：28401_hyakunen⟧{近|ちか}く⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: A struggle that split the country in two continued for nearly a hundred years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二分|にぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧だ。
examples.english: It is one half of the whole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二分|にぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{減|へ}らした→減らす：02414_herasu⟧。
examples.english: I reduced the sugar to one half.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三十年|さんじゅうねん}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二分|にぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧しまった。
examples.english: The population of this town has fallen to half of what it was thirty years ago.

notes:
⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧ (two) + ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (part, division). As a suru-verb it is transitive: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二分|にぶん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{世論|よろん}→世論：16145_yoron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二分|にぶん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to split public opinion
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二分|にぶん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: opinion is divided in two
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二分|にぶん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to share the spotlight (of two rivals)
- {二分|にぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧: one half

READING CAUTION:
The same characters read ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ふん mean 'two minutes.' The division sense is always にぶん, so the reading tells you which is meant: {二分|にふん}⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (wait two minutes) versus {二分|にぶん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (divide in two).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧: half — the everyday noun for the resulting portion, not the act of dividing
- ⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}する→分割する：21140_bunkatsusuru⟧: to divide up — into any number of parts, not specifically two
